_comment: Realistic example day (tools/make_example_day.py): CC photos + TTS dialogue. Same schema as agent_day.json; stream captions/OCR are ground truth for each shot, 'said' is its dialogue. questions[].modality: visual | speech (needs transcripts) | both | none (must decline).

stream.caption: Close-up of black coffee in a patterned retro mug on a table.
said: Morning. First coffee of the day, I definitely need it.

stream.caption: Low view of a bunch of keys and a black leather wallet lying on a cream shag rug.
said: Okay, my keys and wallet are on the rug by the bed. Don't forget them.

stream.caption: Yellow bus stop pole with a timetable sign on a quiet suburban street.
Close-up of a bus timetable panel listing route 24 to Discovery Park.
stream.ocr:
24 to Discovery Park
via Seattle Center, Elliott Ave W, Pier 91
Bus leaves 4th Ave S & S Jackson St at:
402 to Lynnwood Transit Center
said: Looks like the twenty four to Discovery Park comes in a few minutes.

stream.caption: Meeting room: several people seated at a table with laptops open; a whiteboard on the back wall.
said: Hi, you must be new here. I'm Priya Shah, I lead the design team.
Grab a seat, we're about to go over the launch plan.

stream.caption: Whiteboard project plan with rows of blue sticky notes, one row per week.
stream.ocr:
WEEK 3: Design
WEEK 4: Design
WEEK 5: Design
WEEK 6: Dev
WEEK 7: Dev
ADMIN API
Infrastructure Recs: Laravel + Backbone
said: So, week three is design, week four we build the admin A P I, and we ship the beta at the end of week seven.

stream.caption: A bowl of ramen with noodles, a soft egg and toppings on a restaurant table.
said: I'll have the miso ramen with an extra egg, please.
Same for me. I'm Marcus, by the way, I'm on the data team.

stream.caption: A second bowl of ramen across the table in a ramen restaurant.
A latte with leaf-shaped latte art in a cup on a saucer at a cafe.
said: Second coffee. A flat white this time.

stream.caption: Office cubicle desk with a monitor, a laptop on a stand, keyboard, desk phone and a mug; keys and a black pouch at the front edge.
said: Back at my desk. I'm putting my wallet in the top drawer so I don't lose it.

stream.caption: Multi-storey car park lift lobby with brick walls, a lift door and signs reading Level 3.
Pocket contents laid out on a wooden table: car keys with a remote fob, a wallet, a watch, a phone, a notebook, a pen, glasses and a pocket knife.
said: Home. Emptying my pockets onto the hallway table. Keys, phone, watch.

stream.caption: Living room with a dark green sofa, an armchair, polished wooden floor and a small Christmas tree.
